question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

He requested the bank to give him more time as at present he was __unable to pay his debts.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bankrupt**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bankrupt** means a person or organization declared in law as unable to pay their debts.

 
 
• **Example -** *His father went **bankrupt** and the family had to sell their home.*​ 
 
 
 
• *​*So, it is clear that the **'Bankrupt'** can be used as a one-word substitute for **'unable to pay his debts.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Destitute** means extremely poor and lacking the means to provide for oneself.
 
• **Meticulous** means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
 
• **Reckless** means to be marked by a lack of proper caution.
